paper_title: Searching for scalar field dark matter with LIGO
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (or equivalently Lambda_gamma^-1 in GeV^-1)
notes: Paper constrains scalar field DM couplings to photon (Lambda_gamma, equivalently d_e) and to electron mass (Lambda_e, equivalently d_me) from LIGO O3 data over 10-5000 Hz (~5e-14 to ~2e-11 eV). The hint of ScalarPhoton matches the photon coupling result (panel b of Fig 3); a separate ScalarElectron limit is also presented (panel a). No numerical tables of the exclusion limits are provided in the text; only a plotted curve (Fig 3) that was smoothed for visual purposes, so no reliable (mass, coupling) data points can be extracted.
